environment.description: ECS task in an isolated private subnet (no NAT, no IGW). The config-service is accessible exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with a VPC endpoint policy restricting Principal to the specific task role ARN (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/mesh-config-reader). The endpoint's security group (sg-0fedcba987654321) allows inbound TCP/8443 only from the task's security group (sg-0abcdef123456789). DNS is configured with private DNS name enabled on the VPC endpoint, so config-service.internal resolves ONLY to the endpoint ENI private IPs (no public resolution path exists). The subnet route table has NO route to 0.0.0.0/0 — only local VPC CIDR and the S3 gateway endpoint prefix list. Additionally, the VPC has enableDnsHostnames=true but the private hosted zone association is removed; resolution goes through the endpoint private DNS only.

config.network: Private subnet, no NAT gateway, no IGW, route table: local + S3 gateway PL only
config.vpc_endpoint: Interface endpoint vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 for config-service with private DNS enabled
config.endpoint_sg: sg-0fedcba987654321: inbound TCP/8443 from sg-0abcdef123456789 only
config.task_sg: sg-0abcdef123456789: outbound TCP/8443 to sg-0fedcba987654321 only, no other egress
config.dns_resolution: VPC endpoint private DNS only, no public DNS path, no private hosted zone
config.container_runtime: ECS Fargate, task role is mesh-config-reader with minimal permissions
